newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Visco confirms DPEF ready next week.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Visco confirms DPEF ready next week.

text.p: Italian Finance Minister Vincenzo Visco confirmed on Thursday that the latest three-year programme of economic targets (DPEF) would be ready by the end of next week.
Speaking to reporters at a seminar in Rome, he also confirmed that Italy's GDP growth for 1997 was still seen at 1.2 percent, the government's official target.
"This year we should see the forecast growth rate," he said.
The DPEF is expected to give indications of savings the government hopes to make from a planned reform of the welfare state. It will also give new 1998 deficit forecasts.
"It will be presented to parliament by the end of next week," Visco said.
